en: Vintage illustrated postcard showing an artist seated outdoors painting a large easel canvas. On the canvas is a realistic view of a long, elegant, classical-style building with multiple windows and chimneys, fronted by a lawn and flowerbeds. The foreground around the artist is filled with flowers and an open paint box. The word 'UDDEVALLA' is printed in the upper right corner.
